name: Clocktimber

facts.predator-prey cycles: Predator and prey populations often rise and fall in lagged cycles.
facts.circadian rhythms: Most organisms keep roughly 24-hour internal rhythms synchronized by light.
facts.Easter Island's deforestation: Rapa Nui lost most of its palm forest, a contested but widely discussed case of resource depletion.

law_text: Everything in this universe beats with a rhythm; periodic waves sweep across the land and punish those who ignore the beat.
